summary:
• Working as A Senior Software Engineer with Concentrix Since October 2025 to December 2025.
• Worked as A Software Engineer with Quest Global, Bangalore Since March2023 to September
2025.
• Worked as A Software Engineer with Cognizant, Bangalore Since August 2019 to August 2022.
Managerial Abilities:
• Possess around 6 years of comprehensive experience in the IT industry, specializing in Java-based
application development and full-stack solutions.
• Adept in Java 8, with strong command over Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Core, and
microservices-based architecture.
• Demonstrated expertise in full-stack development leveraging React JS, Spring Boot, Node JS, and
SQL Developer across diverse enterprise applications.
• Containerized applications using Docker and managed deployments via Kubernetes, including
orchestrating services on Amazon EKS and Azure AKS.
• Demonstrated expertise in full-stack development leveraging React JS, Spring Boot, Node JS, and
Python for scripting, automation, and backend API development.
• Experienced in building Python-based automation scripts for API testing, log analysis, and data-
driven tasks, reducing manual efforts and improving delivery efficiency.
• Proficient in developing REST APIs using Flask/Django, and utilizing Python libraries like
Pandas, NumPy for data processing and analytics.
• Hands-on experience in integrating Python automation with Postman, Jenkins, and CI/CD
pipelines for continuous testing and faster deployments.

• Integrated RESTful APIs across distributed services for seamless communication between
frontend and backend modules.
• Utilized PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Azure SQL to design efficient, normalized databases for high-
volume applications.
• Proficient in architecting, building, and maintaining scalable web applications and enterprise-grade
backend services.
• Engineered high-performance backend systems using Spring Boot and Node JS to support
business-critical applications.
• Created modular, reusable React components and managed state efficiently using Redux and
Context API.
• Followed best practices in cloud cost optimization, logging, and monitoring using AWS
CloudWatch and Azure tools.
• Hands-on experience in designing and integrating RESTful APIs, along with seamless integration
of third-party services.
• Skilled in using Git and Bitbucket for source control, and experienced with JIRA for agile tracking
and sprint planning.
• Familiar with continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) practices, including pipeline creation
and automation using Jenkins.
• Well-versed in writing unit tests with JUnit and Mockito, and conducting performance testing
using JMeter.
• Strong database skills including SQL query development, schema design, and ORM-based data
interaction.
• Experienced in analyzing requirements, drafting technical documentation, and preparing system
architecture and design specifications.
• Implemented secure authentication and authorization mechanisms to ensure application-level
security.
• Utilized Postman extensively for API testing and automation to validate service reliability and
performance.
• Active contributor in Agile teams, participating in stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and
regular progress updates.
• Collaborated effectively with QA, DevOps, and Product teams to deliver high-quality, production-
ready features.
• Led the team during Java 8 migration initiatives, ensuring compliance with coding standards and
best practices.
• Recognized as a dependable team player with strong communication skills, adaptability, and the
ability to thrive in high-pressure environments.
